prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but “best” depends on what kind of coverage you need and where exactly in the Kansas City area you are (the metro spans both Missouri and Kansas). A few quick questions will let me find and recommend the right local brokers:

- Do you need individual/family (ACA) coverage, Medicare, Medicaid, or small‑group/employer coverage?
- Are you on a tight budget or do you prioritize a specific provider/hospital network?
- Which ZIP code or side of the metro (Kansas City, MO vs. Overland Park/Kansas) are you in?

If you want recommendations right away, I can search for licensed, highly rated brokers near your ZIP and return 3–5 options with contact info and a short note on specialties.

How to choose a good broker (quick checklist you can use now)
- Licensing: verify license on the Missouri or Kansas Department of Insurance site.
- Independence: ask whether they represent multiple carriers (independent) or just one insurer.
- Experience & specialty: confirm they have recent experience with the plan type you need (ACA, Medicare, small group).
- Fees/compensation: most brokers are paid by carriers, but ask if they charge any client fees.
- Ongoing service: will they help with enrollment, claims issues, renewals, and network questions after you enroll?
- References & reviews: check Google/Yelp/BBB and ask for client references.
- Red flags: high‑pressure sales, unwillingness to put recommendations in writing, poor online reviews about not helping with claims.

Useful interview questions to ask a broker
- Which carriers and plans do you usually recommend for people with my needs?
- Can you show me a total‑cost comparison including premiums, deductibles, copays, and out‑of‑pocket max?
- How do you handle plan renewals and claims advocacy?
- Are you licensed in KS and/or MO? Can I see your license number?
- Do you charge any fees to clients?

Tell me your ZIP code and plan type and I’ll pick 3–5 vetted brokers in Kansas City and summarize why each might fit your needs.
